review_candidates.title: Israel Country Sales Leader
review_candidates.location: Tel Aviv-Yafo, Tel Aviv District, Israel
review_candidates.description: Job Requisition ID JR2024628 Job Category Sales Time Type Full time Israel is one of the most consequential AI markets in the world relative to its size - a dense concentration of AI-native companies, frontier startups, sovereign and defense programs, and a deep engineering base. We are looking for a Country Leader to own NVIDIA’s business, strategy, and presence in Israel end to end: a strategic, externally credible leader who is equally comfortable setting country strategy with global stakeholders and getting hands-on with customers, partners, and developers. This person will own the number across all segments and be the face of NVIDIA in the market - with customers, partners, government, ecosystem, and press. Success in this role will manifest in a clear, endorsed Israel country strategy with segment-level plans and an aligned coverage and partner model; Revenue delivered against plan, with a healthier and more predictable forecast across all segments; A named, prioritized AI-native portfolio with measurable engagement and conversion into strategic accounts - including companies NVIDIA was not previously close to. Materially higher NVIDIA visibility and influence in the market: forums, media, government and ecosystem relationships; A strengthened country team, a robust partner ecosystem, and an Israel agenda that global leadership actively engages with. What You’ll Be Doing Country business performance. Define and execute the Israel sales and business strategy; own revenue across enterprise, MOD and defense/security, government and sovereign, AI natives, industry verticals, education, NCPs and ISVs. AI natives. Israel is central to NVIDIA’s AI-native strategy. Systematically identify, attract, engage emerging AI companies early - before they are obvious - and help them build and scale on NVIDIA’s platform, grow them into strategic accounts. Ecosystem and partners. Drive the partner ecosystem across OEMs, ISVs, CSPs, and channel; build the coverage model and capacity needed to scale. Ensure the teams have the right technical resources and capabilities to support such motions. Developer relations and Inception. Lead developer engagement, Inception, community, and ecosystem development programs as a core growth engine, not an adjunct. Operational discipline. Run a rigorous cadence of activities to drive the local business; match demand and supply across strategic accounts and manage allocation trade-offs. Voice of NVIDIA in Israel. Represent NVIDIA at industry forums, executive engagements, and with the press - including interviews and on-record commentary. Team leadership. Nurture, lead, and further develop a high-performing, cross-functional country team, and attract top talent. Maintain strong levels of communication and alignment with the broader NVIDIA operations in Israel, with EMEA and HQ. Advocacy. Put Israel on the map internally - secure attention, investment, and executive engagement from the US and EMEA for the market’s priorities – and externally, amongst other, helping local AI natives access global customers, partners, and markets. What We Need To See Experience and academic background. A B.Sc. or B.A. degree or equivalent experience. 18+ years of overall experience, with at least 6 years as a manager in the following fields. Deep Israeli market knowledge. An established network and genuine standing across enterprise, MOD and security, government and sovereign, AI natives, healthcare, education, and the startup and ISV ecosystem - knows the leaders and the real decision makers. Technology and AI credibility. Can hold a substantive conversation with a CTO, a founder, a research lead, or a minister, understands and is genuinely interested in where technology is going, how AI delivers value at the application layer, how Nvidia technologies are intertwined with its diffusion across industries and applications. Proven commercial acumen and team leadership at scale. Track record of building and leading commercial and technical teams. Proven success in delivering against significant revenue targets. Proven ability to make decisions with speed and certainty. High energy levels to lead and thrive in a fast-paced environment and ultimately deliver against high expectations. Executive presence and external voice. Comfortable and effective on stage, in the boardroom, and with media. Cognizant of the transformational role that NVIDIA has in leading the current technology platform shift and capable to convey its significance. Cross-organizational navigation and Partner ecosystem fluency. Demonstrated ability to align and influence across US and EMEA organizations by virtue of competence and deep understanding of the local market rather than hierarchical mandate. Hands-on experience building and monetizing OEM, ISV, CSP, and channel relationships. Cultural fit. Thrives in a fast-moving, flat, highly communicative, collaborative structure; low ego, high ownership, comfortable with ambiguity and speed, very hands-on. Language. Fluent Hebrew and English required. Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd Holding an MBA or higher education. Entrepreneurial mindset and founder experience. Proven track record as a company founder/co-founder, or having led a startup from inception through rapid growth and scaling. Proven innovation leadership. Demonstrated experience driving corporate innovation initiatives, leading open-innovation hubs, or partnering closely with frontier technology incubators and VCs to commercialize breakthrough technologies.

review_candidates.title: IC Lead Engineer Automation Engineering
review_candidates.description: At Jabil (NYSE: JBL), we are proud to be a trusted partner for the world's top brands, offering comprehensive engineering, supply chain, and manufacturing solutions. With 60 years of experience across industries and a vast network of over 100 sites worldwide, Jabil combines global reach with local expertise to deliver both scalable and customized solutions. Our commitment extends beyond business success as we strive to build sustainable processes that minimize environmental impact and foster vibrant and diverse communities around the globe. Job Summary Designs, analyzes, modifies, and integrates robotics, automation, technologies and processes related to equipment and tooling for applicability to programs and products. Develops, implements, and tests preventative maintenance plans, interim solutions for damaged and unsafe equipment, and tooling. Investigates and documents engineering changes and controls equipment and tooling configuration in accordance with standard operating procedures. Develops and recommends equipment reliability improvements through the application of reliability engineering tooling. Education & Experience Typically requires 4 -8 years of experience Typically College or university degree required Responsibilities Lead project delivery across design, analysis, integration, and validation of automation systems; define architectures, specifications, and acceptance criteria; guide test planning, data collection, and performance verification; drive reliability engineering and maintainability improvements; manage change control, documentation, and configuration integrity; coordinate cross-functional interfaces and readiness for deployment; embed safety, quality, and compliance in solutions; mentor contributors and promote standardized practices to ensure operational excellence. Skills/ Ability Generic (High Level) Exhibit advanced proficiency in automation principles, robotics, and system integration; plan and manage scope, schedule, and risk effectively; communicate requirements and decisions with clarity; analyze complex datasets and test evidence for informed decision-making; apply reliability, maintainability, and validation methodologies; lead continuous improvement and standardization initiatives; foster collaboration across technical and operational teams. Опис посади Здійснює проєктування, аналіз, модифікацію та інтеграцію рішень у сфері робототехніки, автоматизації, технологій і процесів, пов’язаних з обладнанням та технологічним оснащенням, для їх застосування у програмах і продуктах компанії. Розробляє, впроваджує та тестує плани превентивного технічного обслуговування, а також тимчасові рішення для пошкодженого або небезпечного обладнання й оснащення. Проводить аналіз і документування інженерних змін, забезпечує контроль конфігурації обладнання та оснащення відповідно до затверджених стандартних операційних процедур. Ініціює та рекомендує заходи з підвищення надійності обладнання шляхом застосування інструментів і методологій reliability engineering. Освіта та досвід Як правило, вимагається 4–8 років релевантного професійного досвіду Повна вища освіта (ступінь бакалавра або магістра) є обов’язковою Основні обов’язки Забезпечує управління реалізацією проєктів у напрямках проєктування, аналізу, інтеграції та валідації систем автоматизації; визначає архітектуру рішень, технічні специфікації та критерії приймання. Координує процеси планування випробувань, збору даних і підтвердження експлуатаційних характеристик. Ініціює та впроваджує заходи з підвищення надійності й ремонтопридатності обладнання. Забезпечує управління змінами, ведення технічної документації та підтримання цілісності конфігурації. Координує взаємодію між функціональними командами та забезпечує готовність рішень до впровадження. Інтегрує вимоги безпеки, якості та відповідності нормативним стандартам у процес розробки рішень. Сприяє розвитку команди шляхом наставництва та впровадження стандартизованих практик для досягнення операційної ефективності. review_candidates.title: Global Rotating Equipment Lead
review_candidates.description: Imagine your career taking you to the depths of innovation and the heights of impact. Our people enable continuous progress. Their commitment, collective expertise, and unique capabilities are the engine room behind SBM Offshore’s True. Blue. Transition. - shaping the future of energy, and beyond. About Us: SBM Offshore is a global leader in deepwater ocean infrastructure, delivering floating production solutions across the full asset lifecycle—from design and construction to installation and operation. Supported by a global team of more than 8,000 professionals, the Company operates a long-term, asset-backed business model that delivers high-availability assets and predictable cash flows. SBM Offshore combines engineering expertise, operational reliability, and selective innovation to support safe, efficient, and lower-carbon energy production, while extending its capabilities into new opportunities across the blue economy. Purpose As Global Rotating Equipment Lead, you are responsible for ensuring the reliability, availability, and efficiency of rotating equipment within the company’s operations. Your role involve the operation, maintenance, and troubleshooting of rotating machinery, including compressors, turbines, pumps, and other related equipment. You work closely with other departments to ensure optimal performance and compliance with safety and regulatory standards. Your role is key in defining the Rotating Equipment strategies for what concerns their monitoring, design improvement and operations and maintenance scopes definition. Responsibilities You drive continuous improvement of Rotating Equipment design and operation best practices for the existing fleet and new builds to make the fleet safer, more reliable and minimize downtimes. You are responsible for governance processes, tools and strategies to drive performance. You are responsible of assurance processes to sustain performance and always be in control. You conduct failure analysis and troubleshooting to diagnose and promptly resolve equipment issues. You contribute to the definition of maintenance programs and schedules for all rotating equipment. You collaborate with other engineers and departments to optimize equipment performance and process efficiency. You ensure compliance with health, safety, and environmental regulations and policies. You participate in the definition of strategies for execution of equipment upgrades, replacements, and new installations. You provide technical support and guidance to operations and maintenance teams. You stay updated on the latest advancements in rotating equipment technology and best practices in the industry. You support the process of new equipment and new technologies qualification to ensure their suitability for Operations and Maintenance. You support the Supply Chain department in the definition of the technical scope for major equipment maintenance and support contract. Education Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering or a related field is required. Certification in vibration analysis or other relevant disciplines Experience Minimum of 6 years of experience in the maintenance and management of rotating equipment in the Oil & Gas industry. Proven ability to lead and motivate a team. Familiarity with industry standards and regulations related to rotating equipment. Knowledge of predictive maintenance technologies and practices. Familiarity with SAP or other enterprise asset management systems. Functional Competencies Mechanical Rotating Equipment - Gas Turbine Mechanical Rotating Equipment - Gas Compressor Mechanical Rotating Equipment - Pumps Process Analysis and Design Reliability, operability and safety Value Creation Monitoring performance and compliance Learning from events Change Management Project control GENERAL INFORMATION SBM Offshore N.V. is a listed holding company that is headquartered in Amsterdam. It holds direct and indirect interests in other companies that collectively with SBM Offshore N.V. form the SBM Offshore Group (“the Company”). For further information, please visit our website at www.sbmoffshore.com. The companies in which SBM Offshore N.V., directly and indirectly, owns investments are separate entities. SBM Offshore is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. SBM Offshore does not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, non-disqualifying physical or mental disability, national origin, veteran status, or any other basis covered by appropriate law. All employment is decided on the basis of qualifications, merit, and business need.

review_candidates.title: Field Service Engineer - Jacksonville, FL
review_candidates.description: Position Description & Qualifications Are you looking for a Field Service Engineer opportunity at a place where you can make a difference every day? Discover this great opportunity in our Jacksonville, FL location. If you love high profile and challenging projects supporting the US Navy - Serco has a great opportunity for you! This SATCOM Field Service Engineer will provide On the Job Training instruction on SATCOM operations, maintenance, and repair of systems. A wide degree of creativity and latitude is expected. Bring your expertise and collaborative skills to make an impact on our military defense and safety of our sailors. Serco supports the US Military as a prime for several contracts. Please visit these links for more information about how Serco supports the U.S. Military https://www.serco.com/na/careers/navy-careers and our Veterans https://www.serco.com/na/careers/veterans-at-serco. In This Role, You Will Serve as Subject Matter Expert for the following: AN/WSC-9(V) NMT (all variants) and/or GBS and/or C-12509 TDMA TIP (all variants), SHF Communication System (all variants); and all supporting patching, cryptographic, and baseband equipment. Provide OJT instruction on SATCOM operations, maintenance, and repair. Develop, plan, coordinate, and conduct SOVT. Report design, reliability, and maintenance problems to program management. Support new system installations, integrations, and upgrades. Install, troubleshoot, maintains and repair products/equipment. Establish testing protocols and standards, providing training and guidance to engineers and technicians. Test interoperability of systems, measures transmission/outputs, troubleshoots and resolves issues, and maintains detailed evaluation and repair reports. Provide innovative solutions to complex functional problems that impact function's success. Lead tasks, including planning, execution, staff oversight, and status reporting for significant initiatives. Lead and direct the work of others. A wide degree of creativity and latitude is expected. To Be Successful In This Role, You Will Have An active Secret security clearance. Ability to obtain and maintain a CAC (Common Access Card). Ability to successfully pass a drug/background screening. Bachelor's Degree and 8 years of experience Or High School Diploma/GED and 10 years of experience in the field. Effective interpersonal and communication (verbal and written) skills. Ability to analyze, troubleshoot and repair SATCOM systems as an individual and in team situations. Ability to assess and respond to situations where standard procedures have failed in isolating or fixing problem equipment. Ability to promptly respond to telephone and email requests for technical support. Ability to travel up to 25% as necessary. Additional Desired Experience And Skills Active Top Secret Clearance Trade school or military training in industrial engineering, electronics technology, information systems, computer science or other related technical field (preferred). Navy SATCOM troubleshooting and/or customer service experience providing technical support to engineers in areas of research, design, development, testing, or manufacturing process improvement. Satellite communication (SATCOM) systems operations, maintenance, and repair in shipboard, submarine, and shore-based environments. Former Military, Navy is preferred. Military Veterans and Spouses encouraged to apply! review_candidates.title: Field Marketing Executive
review_candidates.description: Who we are? Silverfin is a cutting-edge cloud software solution built by accountants, for accountants. Founded in 2013, Silverfin was created to solve the frustrations of manual, error-prone processes in analysing financial data and compliance. From day one, we’ve been a cloud-first platform with an open API architecture, leveraging structured data to transform how accountants work. Our mission is simple: to enhance and support the accountancy profession through AI and automation, ensuring accountants remain relevant and respected in the future of finance. In 2023, Silverfin became part of the Visma Group, joining one of Europe’s leading providers of cloud software. This partnership strengthens our ability to innovate and expand our impact within the accountancy industry. Today, Silverfin is trusted by over +1000 firms across 19 countries. Our clients include all of the Big 4 accounting firms, as well as leading global networks like BDO, PKF, Baker Tilly, Grant Thornton, and Moore. Headquartered in Ghent, with offices in Mont-Saint-Guibert (BE), London (UK), Luxembourg (LU), and Gouda (NL), we’re a team of over 200 people - including a diverse remote engineering team working across multiple time zones - all working together to drive innovation in accounting. How would you support our success? Your role In response to the growing demands within our dynamic marketing team, we're on the lookout for a Field Marketing Executive to join our team in The Netherlands. Your focus area will include a mix of marketing and event activities. You will be supporting events, digital, customer and partner marketing and other field marketing activities in The Netherlands, mostly centred around our new hub in the vibrant region between Utrecht, The Hague, and Rotterdam. The position includes occasional off-site event coordination during office hours. That means organising events with project boards on Monday.com, messaging, creatives, stakeholders and budgets will be a very important responsibility in this role, next to regular marketing campaigns to our audience of accounting practices in the region. As part of this journey, you'll be in sync with a fantastic team of 17 marketing team members across Belgium and the UK. Reporting directly to our Senior Field Marketing Manager in the Benelux, Your main focus region is The Netherlands. We provide a permanent contract on a full-time basis. Silverfin moves fast with a constant flow of activities for both users and prospects, not to mention our incredible team. We also prioritise the well-being of our people, offering a range of initiatives. Envision yourself joining our international Marketing team and a diverse, motivated team, and growing along with Silverfin. What would you do to drive our success? Your responsibilities Collaborate with your BU stakeholders to define and refine the marketing plan for the Netherlands. Along with your Field Marketing Manager and global marketing demand and content, design and execute targeted marketing campaigns aimed at generating leads and increasing demand utilising a variety of channels, including email, social media, PPC, and content marketing. Work closely with the sales team to ensure they have the marketing materials including assisting in the creation of sales enablement tools such as presentations, brochures, and case studies. Plan, organise, and execute both hosted and 3rd party events from concept to completion. This includes venue selection, vendor management, promotional activities, and post-event analysis. Measure and report on the effectiveness of marketing campaigns and events, using data to support decisions and improve future marketing strategies. Liaise with product, sales, customer success and marketing teams to ensure cohesive brand messaging and optimise campaign success Manage internal and external creative agencies to produce content such as video, copywriting, stand building etc. Manage the marketing budget for the Netherlands with expenses and allocation of budget spends Improve account engagement and penetration in our target accounts. What will support your success? Experience and Qualifications Bachelor/Master in Marketing Proven marketing experience in B2B SaaS (2-5 years) But even more important is your eagerness to deliver results and proactive attitude. Attitude and personality-related traits We’re looking for someone who can work autonomously, has a pragmatic approach, and is eager to deliver results. Skills and knowledge Essential: Copywriting skills in NL (Dutch) Dutch AND English knowledge Strong planning & prioritising skills. Organised (KANBAN), punctual (Deadlines), and meticulous (Quality). Salesforce: create campaigns, dashboards, and reports for your campaigns Hubspot - followup on emails, landing pages, segmentation Tools like “Monday”, “Slack”, “Google Drive/Docs/Sheets”, “Canva”, “Eventbrite”, “Wordpress” Event management of in-person events Big Plus: Paid advertising campaign experience on LinkedIn Comfortable running webinars/podcasts Experience in devising & executing a marketing plan + budget Experience with ABM programmatic and 1 to few We care for you Be part of something bigger – Join a growing SaaS company that’s now proudly part of Visma, Europe’s leader in mission-critical cloud software. A connected team – Take part in regular team activities, retreats, and offsites to keep our culture thriving. Grow with us – Take advantage of career development opportunities and a personal training allowance to support your growth. Time to recharge – Enjoy our company-wide Wellbeing Days off each month (reviewed annually) . Fair compensation – Receive a competitive rewards package with benefits tailored to your role. Flexibility with connection – We have a hybrid setup, with a minimum of two days a week in the office. However, we understand that life can be unpredictable, so we offer flexibility to accommodate unexpected events. Our offices in Belgium (Ghent), the UK (London – Old Street / Shoreditch), the Netherlands (Gouda), Mont-Saint-Guibert, and Luxembourg provide great spaces to collaborate and connect. €63,750 - €86,250 a year Please note: Most candidates start at the lower to mid part of the range, depending on experience and how their profile compares to our existing team. The higher end of the range is typically offered to individuals with a track record of strong impact and deep expertise in similar roles. We run annual compensation reviews, so there is clear opportunity for growth as you progress in the role. How we work At Silverfin, we're an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, ethnicity, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, or disability status. We're committed to elevating talent by creating an environment where we can all thrive together. We have a unique culture with our values as the backbone: Who we are - Authentically human How we think - With a growth mindset How we act - Bravely, side by side How we win - By doing what we love At Silverfin we make our own way. We are constantly looking for new and innovative ways to move forward. Continuous learning and development is encouraged to support your personal and professional growth. At the same time, this opens up many new opportunities that allow our people to grow with Silverfin, and often faster than with other companies. So many ambitious team members have already found their way to a new challenge within Silverfin. We want you to reach your full potential. To get you there, we don't want to think in boxes and over-structure things. So your options are not limited to 1 team or 1 career track. Your talent, motivation and potential play a crucial role in evolving across the teams into new roles.

review_candidates.title: Elektronikingenjörer
review_candidates.description: Elektronikingenjör till IKG Vill du utveckla framtidens produkter tillsammans med några av Sveriges ledande teknikföretag? På IKG söker vi elektronikingenjörer som vill kombinera teknisk utveckling med trygghet, gemenskap och långsiktig karriärutveckling. Din roll Som elektronikingenjör kan du bland annat komma att jobba med konstruktion knuten till embeddedområdet. Beroende på kund och uppdrag så kommer du att ges möjlighet att arbeta med hårdvarukonstruktion både i analoga och digitala system samt med komponentval, systemering, schemaritning/planering samt test och verifiering. I de allra flesta uppdragen har du även kontakt med underleverantörer samt produktion. Våra kunder är högteknologiska bolag inom branscher så som konsumentprodukter, fordon, försvar, radarprodukter och robotik. Hos oss får du möjlighet att arbeta med varierande produkter, tekniker och system samtidigt som du bygger värdefull kompetens för framtiden. Vi söker dig som Är civil- eller högskoleingenjör inom elektronik, elektroteknik, mekatronik eller motsvarande Har flertalet års erfarenhet, gärna inom produktutvecklande verksamhet Har kunskap inom exempelvis analog- och digital elektronik, PCB-design eller inbyggda system Har erfarenhet av testning, verifiering och felsökning av elektronik Har ett stort teknikintresse och drivs av att utveckla innovativa lösningar Kommunicerar obehindrat på engelska, både i tal och skrift Meriterande Kunskaper inom PLC-system, distribuerade I/O, fältbusskommunikation, systemarkitektur, och/eller funktionsutveckling är meriterande Kommunicerar obehindrat på svenska, både i tal och skrift Vi lägger stor vikt vid dina personliga egenskaper och söker dig som är nyfiken, ansvarstagande och trivs med att samarbeta för att nå gemensamma mål. Därför väljer ingenjörer IKG På IKG kombinerar vi tryggheten hos en etablerad arbetsgivare med möjligheten att arbeta i framkant hos spännande kunder. Vi tror att människor utvecklas bäst när de känner delaktighet, får rätt förutsättningar och har kul på vägen. Hos oss får du bland annat: ✅ Fast månadslön, oavsett uppdrag ✅ Sex veckors betald semester ✅ Friskvårdsbidrag på 5 000 kronor per år ✅ Bonusmöjligheter på upp till 2 000 kronor per månad ✅ Kollektivavtal med tjänstepension, försäkringar och föräldraledighetstillägg ✅ Företagshälsovård ✅ Spännande och varierande uppdrag hos ledande teknikföretag ✅ Möjlighet att utveckla din kompetens inom olika tekniker, produkter och branscher ✅ Ett engagerat team och regelbundna aktiviteter, nätverksträffar och IKG-event Varför IKG? På IKG är människan lika viktig som tekniken. Vår ambition är att alla konsulter ska ha rätt uppdrag, rätt förutsättningar och möjlighet att utvecklas över tid. Genom nära dialog med din konsultchef och en kultur som präglas av delaktighet, enkelhet, ansvar och resultat skapar vi en arbetsplats där du både kan växa och trivas. Vi tror på långsiktiga relationer, både med våra kunder och våra medarbetare. Därför är vi måna om att hitta uppdrag som matchar just dina ambitioner, intressen och styrkor. Välkommen till IKG Låter det som nästa steg i din karriär? Vi ser fram emot att höra från dig!

review_candidates.description: Valante Capital busca un/a Analista de Transformación y Creación de Valor para apoyar la evaluación de oportunidades de inversión y la ejecución de programas de transformación en empresas de consumo masivo y retail. La posición trabajará junto a Vicepresidentes y Asociados en análisis comerciales, operativos y financieros, debida diligencia, seguimiento de KPIs y preparación de materiales para inversionistas. How You'll Contribute Apoyar a Vicepresidentes y Asociados en la revisión de oportunidades de inversión y el seguimiento de empresas en cartera. Participar en procesos de debida diligencia comercial y operativa, incluyendo análisis de canales, portafolio, capacidades de equipo y competencia. Construir, bajo supervisión, análisis para validar sinergias comerciales y operativas. Apoyar la elaboración de casos de negocio y materiales de soporte para stakeholders e inversionistas. Analizar información de ventas, márgenes, clientes, canales, precios, costos, productividad y procesos operativos. Contribuir con iniciativas de transformación en ventas, pricing, procura, costos, capital de trabajo, procesos, organización y tecnología. Levantar información de mercado, canal y competencia mediante fuentes primarias y entrevistas con equipos de compañías en cartera. Mapear procesos y estructuras organizativas, documentar hallazgos y convertirlos en planes de acción concretos. Preparar secciones de presentaciones gerenciales, reportes de inversionistas, dashboards y documentos para virtual data rooms. Dar seguimiento semanal a iniciativas de transformación, planes de trabajo y KPIs. What Makes You a Great Fit Pregrado en Ingeniería Industrial, Administración, Economía o carreras afines. Entre 1 y 2 años de experiencia en consultoría, operaciones, gestión comercial o gestión de canales. Se valorará experiencia en empresas de consumo masivo, retail o sectores relacionados. Dominio avanzado de Excel y PowerPoint. Conocimientos intermedios de análisis comercial y operativo. Nivel de inglés intermedio. Conocimientos básicos de herramientas de inteligencia artificial y diagnóstico de canales. Capacidad analítica para interpretar datos comerciales, operativos y financieros básicos. Alta atención al detalle, autogestión y capacidad para manejar escenarios y prioridades en paralelo. Orientación a la ejecución, adaptabilidad, recursividad y disposición para trabajo de campo. Comunicación asertiva y habilidad para colaborar con equipos internos y stakeholders externos.

This is a critical position that works on our US Postal Service security and alarm monitoring team. This team 24/7 continuous monitoring and emergency dispatch services for USPS hubs, outlets, offices and distribution centers. This role provides centrally managed technical support in the areas of alarm panel programming, diagnostic and service support, customer account support and support to contract field technicians. Position Responsibilities Provide centrally managed technical support in the areas of alarm panel programming, diagnostic and service support. Provide customer account support. Provide support to contract field technicians. Run reports from databases (RAMIV Preferred), program alarm panels, and operate alarm monitoring software. Create reports, documents, and correspondence using Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, and Outlook). Candidates must be able to pass a USPIS Moderate Background Investigation (MBI) and obtain a USPS Public Trust (elevated) clearance. This requires US Citizenship and the ability to pass an in-depth background check. Required Skills Possess a high school diploma or General Educational Development (GED) diploma. Be a citizen of the United States of America. Be 18 years of age or older. Be able to attain and maintain a USPIS Moderate Background Investigation (MBI) Clearance. Be able to sit for an extended period of time while monitoring multiple computer monitors. Be able to maintain professionalism under highly stressful situations. Be able to read and comprehend the English language; including, printed regulations, written instructions, training material, etc. Be able to write reports, and document events in a concise and accurate manner. This includes the ability to proofread all documentation for grammar, spelling, and punctuation. Be able to speak the English language clearly and fluently. Digital Alarm System set-up, troubleshooting, and test experience is preferred. We Value Attracting and developing top talent and high-performing teams Fostering a culture that is engaging, accountable, and mission-driven Meet the challenge. Well known companies discount scheme. Develops and promotes best practices, support processes, and knowledge management initiatives to improve organizational effectiveness. review_candidates.title: Customer Support Engineer
review_candidates.description: Company Introduction TLD is the largest global manufacturer of Ground Support Equipment in the aviation and aerospace industries. We deliver technology-focused solutions with a broad range of products, which are designed, engineered, and built, at one of our nine worldwide facilities. TLD is an integral part of ALVEST, a global collection of businesses with strong leadership and product positioning in commercial / general aviation, air cargo and military aviation. The corporate portfolio is one of diverse companies with financial strength and similar culture, who are focused on diversity, sustainability, growth and customer service. A career at TLD is a unique opportunity for individual growth and achievement working with a talented global team, having the common goal of providing a commitment to excellence. We offer a stable, family focused environment with support to accomplish personal and professional goals. Join the TLD team, and be a part of our continued success as the industry leader in the Ground Support Equipment industry. Position Summary The Product Support Engineer serves as the primary technical liaison between customers, sales and service organizations, manufacturing, quality, and engineering teams. This role is responsible for supporting TLD Ground Support Equipment (GSE) products throughout their lifecycle by resolving complex technical issues, leading root cause investigations, supporting product improvements, and ensuring customer satisfaction. The Product Support Engineer combines hands-on troubleshooting with engineering analysis to improve product reliability, support global service organizations, and provide feedback that drives continuous product innovation. Essential Duties And Responsibilities Technical Support & Customer Assistance: Provide advanced technical support for electrical, mechanical, hydraulic, pneumatic, HVAC, diesel engine, PLC, and structural systems used in TLD Ground Support Equipment. Support field technicians, customers, and global service organizations in the diagnosis and resolution of product-related issues. Respond to technical inquiries from sales, service, manufacturing, and customer organizations promptly. Review customer technical specifications and ensure product compliance with contractual and performance requirements. Support commissioning, startup, and field performance evaluations when required. Product Improvement & Engineering Support Conduct root cause investigations of product failures and field-reported issues using structured problem-solving methodologies. Analyze warranty claims, demerits, service reports, and reliability data to identify trends and recommend corrective actions. Collaborate with engineering, manufacturing, quality, and suppliers to develop and implement permanent corrective actions. Create Engineering Change Requests (ECRs) and provide design recommendations to improve product performance, reliability, maintainability, and safety. Act as the voice of the customer by providing field feedback to engineering teams during product development and product improvement initiatives. Documentation & Training Develop and maintain technical service bulletins, troubleshooting guides, repair procedures, and technical communications. Assist in the development and maintenance of product manuals, service documentation, and technical datasheets. Develop field test procedures and validation plans to verify corrective actions and product improvements. Support technical training programs for service technicians, distributors, customers, and internal personnel. Compliance & Continuous Improvement Support quality initiatives and corrective action processes in accordance with ISO 9001 requirements. Participate in continuous improvement activities focused on product quality, reliability, customer satisfaction, and operational efficiency. Maintain technical proficiency through ongoing training, seminars, trade shows, and industry events. Perform other duties as assigned by management. Qualifications And Experience To perform this position successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The qualifications listed below are representative of the knowledge, skills, and abilities required. 3-7 years of experience supporting industrial equipment, heavy machinery, mobile equipment, transportation equipment, aerospace support equipment, or related products. Experience troubleshooting complex electrical, hydraulic, mechanical, HVAC, diesel engine, and control systems. Experience conducting root cause analysis and implementing corrective actions. Experience interacting directly with customers, service organizations, and cross-functional engineering teams. Practical hands-on troubleshooting experience is highly preferred. Other Skills And Abilities Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite. Experience with ERP/MRP systems. Familiarity with CAD drawings and engineering documentation. Experience with PLC-based control systems and troubleshooting is preferred. Experience with diagnostic tools, data acquisition systems, and technical reporting. Familiarity with ISO 9001 quality systems. Adobe Acrobat and technical publishing software experience preferred. Education Bachelor's Degree in Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering or a related technical discipline. Equivalent combination of education and relevant technical experience may be considered. Preferred Characteristics The ideal candidate is a hands-on engineer who enjoys solving challenging technical problems, working directly with customers, and driving product improvements from concept through implementation. This individual thrives in a fast-paced environment and serves as a critical link between the field and engineering organizations. The Company is committed to protecting the confidentiality, integrity, and availability of its information assets in alignment with ISO 27001. All employees are required to follow information security policies, safeguard company data and systems, and promptly report any suspected security incidents or violations.
